aliases: Kioka (possibly, as invoked by the Magon on vol6_p17)
Possibly another name for Aghnar the main character (explicitly unresolved)
appearances: source: vol6_p12-p13; page: p12-p13; description: Silver-haired youth who can float (possibly via specialized footwear); asserts sworn brotherhood with the ape Aghnar; insists on ascending above the mushroom domes despite warnings.

source: vol6_p15; page: p15; description: Silver-haired humanoid with extended metal claws fighting through alien tribal creatures; a smaller creature recites the Magon legend of the 'little no-hair white ape' who will take the Magon people to the fog world and diamond planet.
source: vol6_p16; page: p16; description: Captured by a giant creature; tears or blasts through the creature's head area in reversal.
source: vol6_p17; page: p17; description: Airborne figure after defeating the giant creature; Magon creatures below invoke 'Kioka' as their master and speak of departure to the Diamond Planet.
important_actions: Rose into the air above the mushroom-dome settlement following the ape Aghnar (vol6_p12-p13)
Fought through alien tribal creatures and confronted the Magon Patriarch (vol6_p15–vol6_p17)
Tore or blasted through a giant creature's head area after being seized (vol6_p16–vol6_p17)
relationships: character: The Ape Companion ('Aghnar'); type: Self-described brother / companion; notes: Sworn brotherhood; follows the ape into dangerous upper territory. Source: vol6_p12-p13.
character: Magon people; type: Prophesied leader ('little white ape'); notes: Magon legend says he will one day take them away to the fog world and diamond planet. Sources: vol6_p15, vol6_p17.
